verdict.rationale: The evidence points against this story: a community thread discusses Terraform's BUSL license change and its vague 'competitive offering' wording, which shows the tool has already been relicensed away from an open license. A contributor also reports PRs taking months to a year to merge, which does not suggest open, community-led governance. No evidence shows an open license or neutral foundation governance, so this applicable axis is unmet. I cite both items because the verdict rests on them.
